selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found one-shot runCommand accumulated stdout/stderr without bounds during execution and sliced only after child close. Autonomous acceptance therefore allowed an output-flooding validation command to grow capture memory until timeout or process exit, despite the returned receipt looking bounded.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich central bottleneck gate; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.source_witness: core/terminal.mjs appended every stdout/stderr chunk to unbounded strings with out+=d and err+=d, then only applied out.slice(-240000)/err.slice(-120000) after the child closed.
pre_fix_reproduction.risk: A validation process can continuously emit output until timeout or exit, increasing Taowind Code memory even though the final receipt is sliced.

changes: runCommand now maintains bounded stdout/stderr tail buffers during execution rather than truncating only after close.
runCommand reports outputCharsObserved plus truncation and dropped-character evidence.
runCommand adds an opt-in maxOutputChars execution budget; exceeding it marks outputLimitExceeded and terminates the contained command tree.
runAcceptance enables a 360000-character output budget and fails closed when that budget is exceeded.
Persistent interactive terminal semantics are unchanged.
Focused POSIX regressions prove output floods are terminated promptly while returned evidence remains bounded.

validation.tests: 12/12 PASS; 0 skipped on the POSIX validation host

truth_boundaries: The 360000-character acceptance budget is a bounded policy, not an OS-level CPU/filesystem/network sandbox.
POSIX output-flood termination is reality-verified. Equivalent Windows descendant-tree termination remains limited by the unresolved Windows process-tree containment gap.
Validation commands can still access filesystem/network resources permitted to the Taowind Code process while they are running.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
